tags.description: Tags to filter monitors. Accepts a string or an array of strings.

monitorTypes.description: The monitor types to filter by, such as `http`. Accepts a string or an array of strings.

locations.description: The location IDs to filter by. Accepts a string or an array of strings.

projects.description: The projects to filter by. Accepts a string or an array of strings.

schedules.description: The schedules to filter by. Accepts a string or an array of strings.

remoteNames.description: A string or an array of strings.

status.description: The monitor statuses to filter by. Accepts a string or an array of strings.

monitorQueryIds.description: The monitor query IDs to filter by. Accepts a string or an array of strings.

configIds.description: The monitor config IDs to filter by. Accepts a string or an array of strings.

showFromAllSpaces.description: If `true`, return monitors from all spaces the user can access.

useLogicalAndFor.description: Apply logical AND for `tags` and/or `locations`. Accepts a string or an array.

dateRangeStart.description: The start of the status window, as datemath (`now-15m`) or an ISO-8601 timestamp.

dateRangeEnd.description: The end of the status window, as datemath (`now`) or an ISO-8601 timestamp.

page.description: The page number for paginated results.

perPage.description: The number of items to return per page.

sortField.description: The field to sort the results by.

searchAfter.description: A JSON array of sort values from the previous page, for cursor-based paging.
